scenes.title: Better AI answers
scenes.vo: Stop scrolling! If ChatGPT keeps giving you boring answers... it's not the AI. It's your prompt.

scenes.title: Give it a role
scenes.try: You are an accountant for small shops.
scenes.vo: Step one. Give it a role! Tell it exactly who to be, like an accountant for small shops.

scenes.title: Add your context
scenes.try: For a 2-person bakery in Pune, budget ₹5,000.
scenes.vo: Step two. Add your context. Who's it for? What's the budget? What are the limits?

scenes.title: Ask for a format
scenes.try: Reply as a 5-row table, under 80 words.
scenes.vo: And step three. Ask for a format. A table, a checklist, or five quick points. Done!

scenes.title: Save this for your next prompt
scenes.question: Which step do you skip: 1, 2 or 3?
scenes.vo: Save this for later, send it to a friend, and comment below. Which step do you always skip?
